title: wg: room-policy-04 optional URI fields lack optional<> encoding
description: Suggestion. §6.5 says machine_readable_policy and human_readable_policy "optionally contain pointers" but types them as bare Uri (L919-966); "Uri parent_room<V>" (L573) has no stated cardinality relative to parent_dependant. mimid: zero-length uri is absent; parent_room has one entry exactly when parent_dependant is set (decisions mimid-1wgh.3.15, .3.18). Fix: optional<Uri>.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY: parent_room cardinality stated; only logging URIs optional issue remains. New issue + editorial.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy/issues/36
Reconciled 2026-10-18: PARTIAL: room-policy#36 covers logging policy URIs; parent_room cardinality NOT filed.
Filed 2026-10-18 (Mark-authorized): remaining part as https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy/issues/36#issuecomment-6254578912
2026-11-02 reconcile: Partly covered. Logging policy URIs filed as mimi-room-policy#36 (open). Remaining, narrow: -04 L272 already says parent_room is zero-length unless parent_dependent, but 'Uri parent_room<V>' is a vector and nothing says it holds exactly one entry when set (optional<Uri> would say it).
close_reason: Filed upstream: Mark's comment on his own issue https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy/issues/36#issuecomment-6254578912 (covers exactly-one entry, malformed cases, optional<Uri> fix).
